trophies.name: Final Fulfillment
trophies.description: Each ordeal paves your path to what you are meant to be.

trophies.name: Home is Behind
trophies.description: The old monkey has told his tale. Onward you must go.

trophies.name: A Spark of Thought
trophies.description: Nothing sparks your talents more than a spark of thought.

trophies.name: Brew of Bravery
trophies.description: Fresh brew in an old cask. May it stir a great task!

trophies.name: Creative Concoction
trophies.description: Tonics are well and good, but not to be wolfed like food!

trophies.name: Happy Harvest
trophies.description: Fields kept trim leave time to skim.

trophies.name: Pound and Perfect
trophies.description: "Through fire, armor is refined; through trials, strength is defined."

trophies.name: Blazing Black Wind
trophies.description: Of all things to learn, you chose to play with fire?

trophies.name: Temple of Taint
trophies.description: Now at an end is the elder's long wait for the journeyer.

trophies.name: A Great Gust
trophies.description: There will be more sages if their maker still engages.

trophies.name: Shifting Sands
trophies.description: The beetle came with drumbeats' call, and left with waves' gentle fall.

trophies.name: Nifty Nonsense
trophies.description: The fat monk failed, for he spoke too much.

trophies.name: Behold the Betrayal
trophies.description: More eyes do not see more than the mortal trifles.

trophies.name: The Cockerel Crowed
trophies.description: Long and short, far and near, each span has its year.

trophies.name: Flaming Fury
trophies.description: The golden child brought fire and smoke; when they cleared, the family broke.

trophies.name: Frost and Flame
trophies.description: The merging of ice and fire, swift and severe.

trophies.name: Meet the Match
trophies.description: "Let go of him, and you let go of all."

trophies.name: A Duel of Destiny
trophies.description: Two minds' long fray leaves but one to stay.

trophies.name: The Clamor of Frogs
trophies.description: Six frogs, six skills—how intriguing!

trophies.name: The Sire and Sons
trophies.description: "For what deed, must the four waters they governed roam free?"

trophies.name: Always Accompanied
trophies.description: How odd to encounter this old man at every corner!

trophies.name: Urge Unfulfilled
trophies.description: "With my life I'll repay the title he gave me!"

trophies.name: Six Senses Secured
trophies.description: After all that strife and struggle, what's truly been gained?

trophies.name: Portraits Perfected
trophies.description: Humans, beasts, yaoguais, and the Bodhisattvas. All recorded and noted.

trophies.name: Treasure Trove
trophies.description: "All the four vessels now belong to me!"

trophies.name: Master of Magic
trophies.description: All spells we know are derived from the same source.

trophies.name: Guardian of Gear
trophies.description: You are fully fitted. Now, swing that staff and fight!

trophies.name: A Curious Collection
trophies.description: Every rare wonder the world can offer, collected and kept.

trophies.name: Medicine Meal
trophies.description: "Here, have it, have it all."

trophies.name: Staffs and Spears
trophies.description: A walking vault of arms you have become!

trophies.name: Mantled with Might
trophies.description: Shoes on feet, hat on head, embroidered shirt, Daoist robe—free as can be, doing as you please!

trophies.name: Fickle Forms
trophies.description: Transformations and Spirit Skills, you have mastered them all!

trophies.name: Brewer's Bounty
trophies.description: What to drink, how to drink, and above all, who to drink with.

trophies.name: Page Preserver
trophies.description: "All the tattered pages can now be compiled in full."

trophies.name: Seeds to Sow
trophies.description: Take more as fruit as your plants take root.

trophies.name: Scenic Seeker
trophies.description: The most marvelous places for meditation have all met your gaze.
